notes: Product-facing package and tool names remain neutral.
Keep legal/source attribution in this metadata and third-party notices when runtime code is synced.
Do not edit generated runtime sources directly (src/_generated/**); update sync.mjs or src/shim/* instead.
Full extraction live: core + leaf SSRF/security + net-policy + normalization-core + fs-safe dist, with hand-written src/shim/* for the plugin-sdk surface.

patches.desc: detect macOS Google Chrome Beta after stable Chromium-family browsers
classify macOS Google Chrome Beta within the Chrome-only fallback
expose managed-profile PID lookup so the host can confirm process exit from the OS, not from CDP endpoint silence (a stalled Chrome stops answering while still alive)
decorate Chrome chip with host displayName so Cindy-real stays disk-only
pass chipName into decorateOpenClawProfile instead of the disk key
preserve narrow fake-IP SSRF allowances from the host config without enabling general private-network access
skip upstream auto-injected "openclaw"/"user" profiles when the host provides its own (avoids CDP port 18800 collision with the managed profile + never drives the user's Chrome)
allow explicit browser proxies only for public hostnames named in the strict hostname allowlist
export a non-blocking quarantine so the popup-overflow path can mark a target unusable without awaiting close() (a hung page must not keep the interaction pending)
propagate proxy mode through Playwright interaction navigation checks
guard direct input file uploads with the proxy navigation policy
guard hover/drag/scrollIntoView/wait interactions with the same proxy navigation policy
apply the effective browser proxy mode to file-chooser click navigation
apply the effective browser proxy mode to direct input file uploads
carry the effective browser proxy mode through interaction navigation guards
one-off hostname grants must also pass a strict hostnameAllowlist (else the loopback CDP endpoint is blocked by proxyAllowedHostnames and every proxied navigation fails)
